name: Testing the Vessel
summary: You return to Witch Doctor Uzer'i, who tests the ritual and your skill. Now you must capture ten wildkin in the Hinterlands and bring them with the vessel back to Feralas.

sections.title: A Vessel for the Hinterlands
sections.body: Witch Doctor Uzer'i tests the ritual you just performed and your own skill. The vessel Uzer'i gives you can shrink a creature and trap it inside. You travel to the Hinterlands to find wildkin. Their kind once belonged to Elune, the night elf goddess, as pets. Uzer'i names the vicious, primitive, savage owlbeasts as your quarry. Capture ten before their spirits slip away, then return with them and the vessel to Uzer'i in Feralas.

sections.title: Afterward
sections.body: Witch Doctor Uzer'i explains what happens when a creature dies violently. Its muisek may escape and hunt for revenge. Shrinking a fallen creature, as you did, keeps the muisek from getting away. Uzer'i now says you may use the vessel at will.

faq.answer: Witch Doctor Uzer'i gives it to you and hands you the vessel.
Uzer'i sends you to the Hinterlands to find wildkin.
The targets are wildkin, vicious, primitive or savage owlbeasts. Uzer'i wants ten.

faq.q: What is the link between the wildkin and Elune?
faq.answer: Uzer'i says wildkin once belonged to Elune, the night elf goddess, as pets.
The vessel shrinks a fallen creature and traps it inside, keeping its spirit from getting away.

aliases: what comes after testing the vessel
faq.answer: The chain continues with Hippogryph Muisek.
